applyTo: "profile.example/**,tools/careerdata.py,tools/qualify.py,tools/cv_suggest.py"

Career data rules. Example data is fictional (Jane Doe) and must stay fictional.
Every bullet needs `id`, `threads`, `tags`, `strength`; a bullet no thread claims never
renders. Never add a claim, number or skill the data does not contain. Changes to
matching or scoring must keep every result explainable: each point in a score traces to
a visible line. Add a test with a real-looking requirement line for any matching change.
